scientific_limitations: Passive planar constant-mobility colloid, exactly periodic position-preserving angle resets, no noise in reset orientation and no confinement. Isotropization only for explicitly aligned Schur-complement anisotropy. Does not treat stochastic clocks.
title: A unique isotropic reset period and diffusion-axis reversal for coupled Brownian colloids
